name: Breadcrumbs
description: Trail from Home to the current page. The design spec builds this from the page tree, but a block cannot read the route (no Nuxt globals, and `useEldraPage()` is page-level) — `trail` is the theme's stand-in: fill it per page from the parent levels above this one.

fields.name: Trail
fields.description: The levels between Home and this page, root first. Not editable from the page tree — fill it by hand per page.

fields.name: Add the product's category trail
fields.description: On a product page, appends the store's own category trail (root category down to the product's) after the levels above. It does nothing on any other page. Turn it off here if you would rather Product detail drew the trail with its own "Show category trail".

fields.name: Current page title
fields.description: Overrides the last crumb's text — use it for long product or article titles.

fields.name: Show current page
fields.description: Off ends the trail at the parent.

fields.name: Container
fields.description: Match the block below: use content above Product detail and Article so the trail lines up with the gallery or title edge.
